name: resolve_filter

test_list.description: A non-empty configured level is used and RUST_LOG is ignored.
An empty level falls back to RUST_LOG.
With neither set the filter is `info`.
A broken RUST_LOG is an error only when it is the source.
Windows: an unpaired-surrogate RUST_LOG is BadFilter, not a panic.

inputs.name: env
inputs.description: Value of RUST_LOG read with var_os by the caller.

output_description: Pure; the environment is read by start().
